item.title: One quarter of Australian kids are ‘developmentally vulnerable’ when they start school. Quality childcare can catch them up

item.description: Australia’s mandatory National Child Safety Training initiative has been recognised for its collaborative approach to strengthening child safety across the early childhood education and care sector, securing a finalist position in the 2026 IPAA ACT Spirit of Service Awards.
